ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Select: Select ISA cabinet for the unified grid
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Attach: Connect selected ISA cabinet to this inverter
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Detach: Disconnect ISA cabinet from the unified grid
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Selected: ISA cabinet selected. Right-click a Live Wire master inverter to connect it.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Joined: ISA cabinet connected to the Live Wire grid.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Detached: ISA cabinet returned to its own power system.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_InvalidTarget: Stand near a valid cabinet or inverter and try again. Both devices must be loaded.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_OutOfRange: The cabinet is beyond the inverter's wiring range.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_AlreadyLinked: This cabinet or inverter already has a unified-grid connection.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_StopBackup: Switch off the ISA backup first. Its generator must be present and unambiguous.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_UnlinkBackup: Unlink this generator in Live Wire and verify the original ISA backup is present before disconnecting.
ContextMenu_SQLWISA_Unavailable: The unified grid is unavailable. Check the game log.
